stepRecords.summary: Recognized a transaction signature on mainnet-beta.
Use Inspect Transaction, with check rules 1.1.0. No model inference or remote script is used.
Public read authorized. No wallet connection, asset approval or transaction signature is requested.
Public data was returned and parsed. The query did not broadcast a chain transaction.
8 passed · 0 failed · 0 unknown. These checks are not a security audit.
Saved in this browser. The record is not public or on-chain.

checks.label: Account indexes resolve
checks.title: Account indexes resolve
checks.finding: Instruction and balance indexes resolve against the complete account list.
checks.limitation: Version 0 lookup accounts use the RPC-expanded key order; unresolved references are kept as unknown.

checks.label: Chain execution outcome recorded
checks.title: Chain execution outcome recorded
checks.finding: The chain transaction failed. Its error is retained; the inspection can still complete.
checks.limitation: This check verifies that the outcome was read, not that the underlying transaction succeeded.

checks.label: Finality evidence
checks.title: Finality evidence
checks.limitation: Finality is separate from task completion.

checks.label: Exact SOL balance and fee arithmetic
checks.title: Exact SOL balance and fee arithmetic
checks.finding: Lamports and fees were parsed without unsafe integer rounding.
checks.limitation: Balance changes include fees, account creation or closure, and wrapped SOL. They are observations, not a buy/sell classification or investment profit.

checks.label: Token balance coverage
checks.title: Token balance coverage
checks.finding: 9 Token account balance changes were read.
checks.limitation: A missing array is not a zero balance. No market price or trade intent is inferred.

checks.label: Internal instruction coverage
checks.title: Internal instruction coverage
checks.limitation: Only instructions present in the RPC response can be inspected.

checks.label: Version-specific resource configuration
checks.title: Version-specific resource configuration
checks.finding: The signed version 1 resource limits and explicit optional fields were read.
checks.limitation: Version 1 limits come from the signed message transactionConfig. Priority fee is a total in lamports, not micro-lamports per compute unit. ComputeBudget instructions do not set version 1 limits. Signed fee configuration is separate from the fee charged in meta.fee.
